title: PIQI Model 2026
description: Schema describing a PIQI data model, comprised of a root entity and a set of data classes, each with attributes and optional attribute roles.

mnemonic.description: Short, unique, upper-case code identifying the model.

description.description: Free-text description of the model, its scope, and review status.

version.description: Integer version number of the model.

baseModel.description: Name/reference of the base model this model extends, if any.

rootEntityName.description: Human-readable name of the root entity represented by this model.

rootEntityMnemonic.description: Mnemonic code for the root entity.

dataClasses.description: The set of data classes that make up the model.

mnemonic.description: Mnemonic code for the attribute type.
Short, unique mnemonic code for the attribute.

shortName.description: Abbreviated display name for the attribute.

fieldName.description: camelCase field/property name used in data payloads.

description.description: Free-text description of the attribute's meaning.

sequence.description: Ordering position of the attribute within its data class.

autoGenerated.description: Whether the attribute is system-generated (e.g., the implicit Data Class / Element entries) rather than user-defined.

isInherited.description: Whether the attribute is inherited from a base model/data class.

roleTypeName.description: Human-readable name of the semantic role played by the referenced attribute.

roleTypeMnemonic.description: Mnemonic code for the role type.

attributeName.description: Name of the attribute (within this data class) that fulfills the role.

attributeMnemonic.description: Mnemonic of the attribute (within this data class) that fulfills the role.

name.description: Human-readable name of the data class.

mnemonic.description: Short, unique mnemonic code for the data class.

description.description: Free-text description of the data class.

shortName.description: Abbreviated display name for the data class.

fieldName.description: camelCase field/property name used in data payloads.

isInherited.description: Whether the data class is inherited from a base model.

sequence.description: Ordering position of the data class within the model.

attributes.description: The attributes belonging to this data class.

roles.description: Semantic role assignments mapping specific attributes in this data class to well-known roles (e.g., start/end datetime).
